entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Is this for real...?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: I'm sure we came the same way...[n]What's goin' on here...?
entries.uk: Я певен, що ми йшли тим самим шляхом...[n]Що ж тут коїться...?

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: That's exactly what I wanted to[n]ask you.
entries.uk: Саме це я й хотів[n]у вас спитати.

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: We received a call from the police.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: That damn cop snitched on us after[n]all!

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: It's rare not to see you alone.

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: Where were you roaming around[n]until this time?
entries.uk: Де ти вештався аж[n]до цього часу?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Uhh... a ca— a castle?

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: So, you have no intention of giving[n]an honest answer?

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: What's this about a "castle"?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Kamoshida!?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: You seem so carefree, Sakamoto.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Quite a difference from when you did[n]morning practice for the track team.
entries.uk: Зовсім не такий, як тоді, коли ходив[n]на ранкові тренування з легкої атлетики.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Shuddup! It's your fault that—

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: How dare you speak that way to[n]Mr. Kamoshida!
entries.uk: Як ти смієш так говорити[n]з паном Камошідою!

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: ...There's not much leeway left[n]for you, you know?
entries.uk: ...Ти ж розумієш, що запасу[n]в тебе вже обмаль?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: He's the one that provoked me!

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: Do you really want to be expelled!?
entries.uk: Ти справді хочеш, щоб тебе виключили!?

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: In any case, you'll have to explain[n]yourself! Follow me!
entries.uk: Хай там як, тобі доведеться пояснити[n]свою поведінку! За мною!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: What!? This is bullshit!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Come now. I should have been more[n]considerate, too. Let's just say that[n]we were both to blame.
entries.uk: Ну годі. Я теж мав бути[n]тактовнішим. Скажімо, що[n]ми обидва винні.

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: Well, if you say so...

entries.speaker: Counselor
entries.en: Still, you're coming with me. It's[n]undeniable that you're extremely late.
entries.uk: Та все одно ти йдеш зі мною.[n]Ти ж страшенно запізнився,[n]цього не заперечиш.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Fine...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: By the way... you're that new[n]transfer student, correct?[n][f 4 3]?
entries.uk: До речі... ти ж той новий[n]переведений учень, так?[n][f 4 3]?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: ...Have we met somewhere?
At the castle.
Nope.
I saw a girl in your car.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Castle, what the...?[n]Oh, I saw you at the station.
entries.uk: Замок, що за...?[n]А, я бачив тебе на станції.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Hm...? Oh, I remember now...[n]I saw you at the station.
entries.uk: Хм...? А, тепер пригадую...[n]Я бачив тебе на станції.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: That's right... I remember now.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: ...Well, I'll overlook this just for today.
entries.uk: ...Що ж, сьогодні я на це заплющу очі.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: I'm sure you've heard from the[n]principal, but cause any trouble[n]and you'll be expelled. Understand?
entries.uk: Певен, директор тобі казав:[n]створиш проблеми — тебе[n]виключать. Зрозумів?

entries.en: I understand.
Can you overlook more?
entries.uk: А можна заплющити й на більше?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Is that supposed to be a joke?[n]I'm not laughing.
entries.uk: Це мав бути жарт?[n]Мені не смішно.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: At any rate, hurry up and go[n]to the faculty office. I'm sure[n]Ms. Kawakami's tired of waiting.
entries.uk: Хай там як, швиденько йди[n]до вчительської. Певен, пані[n]Кавакамі вже втомилася чекати.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Good luck trying to enjoy your[n]new school life.
